provenance: From a reference run of Windows PowerShell 5.1 (the .NET Framework runtime 4.0.30319.42000) on 2026-10-13. `seconds[n - 1]` is the length in years the game makes of a cycle of n seconds (n from 1 to 10000, the cycle as the double n / 86400 days): the days times 86400 as a double read as a decimal, divided by 31536000 as a decimal, the quotient taken to a double by the platform's own conversion and read back as a decimal, as text. `others` is the same for other cycle lengths, as [IEEE 754 bits of the days as 16 hex digits, text]. `doubles` is [text of a decimal, IEEE 754 bits of the double the platform's own conversion makes of it], with mantissas under 2^53, from 2^53 to 2^63, from 2^63 to 2^64 and of more than 64 bits.
